pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, gentle gayageum harmonics and warm ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced softly in the first 10 seconds)

햇살이 너를 감싸던 그날처럼
내 마음도 따뜻해져 가

수많은 계절이 지나가도

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation adding emotional tension)

[DROP]

[Chorus]

하루가 다르게 빛나가는 세상
너로 인해 아름다워져
이 순간, 영원히 기억할게

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding tender depth)

별빛이 우리를 비추는 이 밤에
너의 눈 속에 나를 비춰봐 feel our hearts
조용한 바람에 실려오는 너의 숨결이 나를 감싸

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat swing, ajaeng low warm stabs, taepyeongso short bright motifs)

Yo, every moment with you feels like a miracle glow
Your smile, your touch, through every season we grow
Gayageum strings whisper, ajaeng holds the soul
Taepyeongso rises, making our story whole
Bass drop heavy in this Joseon night
Your breath in the wind, everything feels right

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum joyful tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring trills, full percussion explosion, female bright adlib)

이 순간, 영원히 remember tonight
너와의 모든 순간 shine bright

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

너와 함께하는 시간들은
모두 행복의 연속이야
하루가 다르게 빛나가는 세상
너로 인해 아름다워져
이 순간, 영원히 기억할게
너와 함께하는 시간들은
모두 행복의 연속이야
내 전부는 너야, 사랑해 forever

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and warm ajaeng drone, whispered male "every moment with you... forever")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
